conditions.current_direction: out to noise_probe to gate; i(Vnoise) is the actual measured branch current
conditions.other_ac_sources: Vin, Vdd, Idist and Vbiasdiag all zero

finite_stop: Exactly one diagnostic circuit: one OP and one AC sweep, native concurrency one. Retain any partial/failed attempt. At most one identical retry for an identified execution failure; no target-driven circuit/threshold/frequency changes. A later advertised clean public replay is known-input reproduction, not another scientific sample.
measurement: One OP then241 complex AC points. Normalize output by measured i(Vnoise); compare frozen complex forecast. Read actual MOS and passives; check full node/MOS KCL, zero Vin/Vdd AC, C through measured current/voltage.
question: Does one current flowing from output into gate produce the complete complex Rt*H-Z path, including the opposite injection signs, on the same finite F75L MOS core?
role: Prospective linear-superposition diagnostic based on known nominal H and Z; no new physical sample, optimization or statistical confirmation
scientific_basis: The four checked old attempts provide separate H and Z paths but no direct combined branch-current trace. This one finite diagnostic tests that circuit/source correspondence and provides a small public replay.
